Homeo Clinic, Barh (1962–2020) | End of an Era
A remarkable story of three generations, a family’s medical legacy, and 58 years of service to the people of Barh, Patna, Bihar.
On 18 August 2020, Homeo Clinic, one of the oldest medical establishments in Barh, Bihar, permanently closed its doors. The building that had witnessed decades of medical practice, countless patients, and generations of memories was demolished to make way for new construction.
But the story of Homeo Clinic began long before 1962.
